TITLE: D.B. Dick's architectural drawings of Edward F. Blake residence in Toronto, Ontario
SCOPE: Series consists of contract drawings depicting plans, elevations, sections and details for additions and alterations to a residence for Edward F. Blake at 449 Jarvis Street in Toronto.
RESTRTX: Access to these records is not restricted.
